mythologicalSource.author: Pausanias
mythologicalSource.notes: Pausanias records wild beasts and wolves roaming the deep pine forests of Mount Cithaeron sacred to Artemis.

actions.name: Snapping Jaws
actions.description: Lurches forward with bared yellow canines aiming for the throat.

actions.name: Circling Feint
actions.description: Darts across the loose limestone scree to strike from the unprotected flank.

mythologicalSource.author: Hesiod
mythologicalSource.notes: The subterranean brood of Echidna and Typhon dwelling in craggy hollows.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.description: Massive jaws close with bone-cracking ferocity.

actions.name: Claw Rake
actions.description: Sweeps curved talons through the air, tearing leather and flesh.

mythologicalSource.author: Strabo
mythologicalSource.notes: Wild nature daimones with horse-tails or goat legs accompanying Dionysus through Parnassian forests.

actions.name: Olive Crook Strike
actions.description: Swings a heavy knotted olive-wood crook with frantic drunken vigor.

actions.name: Hoof Kick
actions.description: Spins on one cloven hoof and kicks backward with bone-cracking force.

mythologicalSource.author: Pausanias
mythologicalSource.notes: Man-eating raptors consecrated to Ares inhabiting the Arcadian marsh with bronze beaks and dart-like feathers.

actions.name: Bronze Beak Pierce
actions.description: Dives from the grey sky, plunging its metallic beak straight through shield leather.

actions.name: Feather Volley
actions.description: Snaps its wings, unleashing a fan of razor-edged bronze quills.

mythologicalSource.author: Pausanias
mythologicalSource.notes: The mysterious mystery sanctuary of the Kabeiroi near Thebes, renowned for metalcraft and subterranean fire.

actions.name: Molten Hammer
actions.description: Slams down a glowing bronze fist forged in sacred subterranean kilns.

actions.name: Smoldering Steam Vent
actions.description: Unleashes a scalding blast of forge steam from iron chest grates.

mythologicalSource.author: Plato
mythologicalSource.notes: Ancient Arcadian wolf-cult where men who tasted sacrificial flesh were transformed into wolves for nine years.

actions.name: Feral Throat-Rip
actions.description: Leaps forward on two legs and claws at your helmet gorget with lupine frenzy.

actions.name: Bloodcurdling Howl
actions.description: Unleashes the terrifying scream of a cursed king, shaking mortal resolve.

mythologicalSource.author: Apollodorus
mythologicalSource.notes: The colossal tusked boar that ravaged the highland fields of Psophis until Herakles drove it into deep snow.

actions.name: Goring Tusk Thrust
actions.description: Lowers its snout and charges forward with curving ivory tusks capable of splitting oak.

actions.name: Trampling Charge
actions.description: Stamps into the dirt and crashes its massive bristling bulk directly into you.

mythologicalSource.author: Hesiod
mythologicalSource.notes: Winged daimones of sudden gusts and storms that snatch away food and souls with filthy talons.

actions.name: Snatching Talons
actions.description: Swoops in screaming with vulture claws raking your shoulders and head.

actions.name: Blinding Whirlwind
actions.description: Beats its wings furiously, throwing dust and gravel into your eyes.

mythologicalSource.author: Aristophanes
mythologicalSource.notes: Chthonic phantom attendant of Hecate with one bronze leg and one donkey leg, shape-shifting to devour wayfarers.

actions.name: Bronze Leg Kick
actions.description: Strikes out with its gleaming bronze leg with ringing metallic power.

actions.name: Vampiric Drain
actions.description: Sinks spectral fangs into flesh, draining life and healing itself.

mythologicalSource.author: Hesiod
mythologicalSource.notes: Spawn of Typhon and Echidna, with the face of a woman, body of a lion, serpent tail, and eagle wings, strangling those who cannot answer her riddle.

actions.name: Strangling Lion Pounce
actions.description: Leaps from the high limestone boulder, crushing down with the full weight of a golden lioness.

actions.name: Eagle Talon Rake
actions.description: Rakes iron talons across the shield, shattering bronze rims.

actions.name: Terrifying Enigma Gaze
actions.description: Her piercing amber human eyes paralyze your limbs with supernatural dread.

mythologicalSource.author: Ovid
mythologicalSource.notes: The gigantic crested serpent guarding the spring of Ares at Thebes, possessing fire in its eyes and triple rows of venomous teeth.

actions.name: Venomous Triple-Bite
actions.description: Strikes like a lightning bolt from the cavern, clamping triple rows of dripping fangs.

actions.name: Serpentine Coils
actions.description: Wraps massive bronze-scaled coils around your torso, squeezing breath from your lungs.

actions.name: Miasmic Venom Breath
actions.description: Exhales a hissing green cloud of toxic chthonic vapor.

mythologicalSource.author: Hesiod
mythologicalSource.notes: The multi-headed water serpent of Lerna reared by Hera to test Herakles; whenever one head was cut off, two grew in its place.

actions.name: Multi-Headed Hydra Strike
actions.description: Multiple draconic heads strike simultaneously from all angles with dripping venom.

actions.name: Toxic Acid Spurt
actions.description: Spits black acidic bile that dissolves bronze armor and blisters skin.

actions.name: Swamp Tail Sweep
actions.description: Sweeps its massive reptilian tail through the marsh water, knocking you into the mud.
